en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate city gate and adjoining fortified walls with a tall square tower. The architecture is Islamic/Maghrebi, with an arched entrance decorated with geometric motifs. In front of the walls are small market stalls and people in traditional clothing walking along a dirt street. Printed caption text in French appears along the bottom margin.
